= DiabolicUI for Wotlk 3.3.5

A full Diablo III-style UI for the WoW 3.3.5a client: Goldpaw's DiabolicUI, forked and extended for 3.3.5.

image::docs/screenshots/main.webp[DiabolicUI in Winterspring]

== 🚀 Install

. Download the zip from https://github.com/apt-get-update/DiabolicUI/releases/latest[the latest release].
. Unzip it into `Interface/AddOns/`.
. In game: `/dui config` for the options, `/dui move` to move frames.

What's new in each version: https://github.com/apt-get-update/DiabolicUI/releases[releases].

== ✨ Features

* *Diablo III style*: health and mana orbs, restyled windows, loot and roll windows; optional GShade for a darker look (see below).
* *All in one*: specializations in one click (talents, gear, bars, macros), GearScore, movable frames, shorter chat.
* *Options*: intuitive and easy to tweak.
* *In combat*: incoming heals on the orbs, gold, XP and loot gained shown at the right.
